body: The Status line still says "TS-TEST-HYG-022 is the manual close of issue #238 after the merge" for issue #241, and only at the end of the line says TS-TEST-HYG-033 replaces it. A reader who stops at the #241 entry gets the old manual step. The functional Status line was already reworded for FR-TEST-HYG-019 ("closed by the merge of the issue #238 change"). Suggested fix: change the #241 parenthesis to "TS-TEST-HYG-022, the manual close of issue #238, is replaced by TS-TEST-HYG-033" and drop the repeat in the #238 entry.

FR-TEST-HYG-027 restates FR-TEST-HYG-020 (same guard, same exact message, same test file). FR-TEST-HYG-029 also mostly repeats FR-TEST-HYG-019 and 021 (issue #238 closed as completed, nothing outside doc/ changes, vet/test pass). Two IDs for one rule can drift apart later: if the message changes, both need updating. This is acceptable as the trace for issue #238, but FR-TEST-HYG-027 could simply say it keeps FR-TEST-HYG-020, adding only the new detail ("fails at once, without stopping the server"), rather than repeating the message.
